Name: Confirm v1 scope and acceptance checks
Completion criteria: Agree all nine requested features for launch with measurable acceptance checks, supported platforms and tester needs; define data ownership and schema contracts for reconnect sync.

Name: Build native apps and test the baseline
Completion criteria: Rebuilt iOS and Android apps open all tabs, log offline and reload saved data; record device/build evidence.

Name: Make logging fast and reliable in the gym
Completion criteria: Phone testing confirms fast set entry, copy/add set, resume after close, empty-session exit, timed work and duplicate-save protection.

Name: Add workout history details and summaries
Completion criteria: Browse older completed sessions and open actual exercises, individual sets, weights, reps/time and totals after reload; saving a workout shows its completion summary with correct actual-set totals.

Name: Correct and delete completed workout mistakes
Completion criteria: Confirmed edits/deletes persist, refresh charts, coaching evidence, streaks and reminders, preserve unrelated data and recover visibly from failed writes.

Name: Add previous values and exercise shortcuts
Completion criteria: Repeat prior actual values with clear context; favorites/recent exercises shorten search without creating completed sets.

Name: Verify upgrades and training data safety
Completion criteria: Upgrades preserve existing workouts/programs/auth; verify migration and data contracts for planned notes, music, supplement, vacation and timer fields before cloud sync; failure/retry and reload checks pass on native and web; no new training reset.

Name: Add program adherence history
Completion criteria: A calendar distinguishes completed training, unscheduled workouts, planned/manual rest and missed training using dated schedule revisions and existing streak rules.

Name: Verify reminder permissions and delivery
Completion criteria: Physical-device evidence covers opt-in/denial/recovery, delivery, completion cancellation, schedule edits, timezone changes and Android delay expectations.

Name: Verify native screenshot import and correction
Completion criteria: Native OCR build/device checks cover clear and blank images, cancel/retry, offline/resume and explicit target/schedule correction; saving leaves imports inactive.

Name: Review coaching policy and define shipped scope
Completion criteria: Qualified review covers thresholds and explanations; decide durable decision history, opt-in behavior and release eligibility for today-only suggestions.

Name: Pilot coaching suggestions and undo
Completion criteria: Only reviewed behavior reaches testers; no-history, long-break, low-readiness, rest, repeated-hard and stale-proposal cases behave correctly; undo works.

Name: Finish optional accounts and onboarding
Completion criteria: Confirm hosted setup, security policies and account ownership/schema contracts for sync/feed by October 25; device-verify signup/confirmation/signin/recovery, avatar/privacy, account deletion and profile/avatar cleanup with explicit local-training-data handling; guest/offline/error flows work.

Name: Verify progress and consistency metrics
Completion criteria: Charts match actual individual sets; timed/warm-up handling and empty/single/multiple-point states are reviewed; history corrections refresh metrics.

Name: Finish phone usability and accessibility
Completion criteria: All v1 flows, including the nine requested features, work at narrow phone sizes in light/dark mode with readable text, usable controls, keyboard/screen-reader behavior and useful error/empty states.

Name: Freeze the v1 feature set
Completion criteria: Target implementation of all nine requested features by November 29; all agreed v1 features meet acceptance checks by December 6 with release gates explicit; only release fixes enter the candidate.

Name: Prepare private beta builds and feedback
Completion criteria: Package installable early core beta builds for selected testers; capture device, build, reproduction and severity; publish incremental builds as features are ready.

Name: Run rolling real gym beta sessions
Completion criteria: Test core flows from November 2, add each ready feature, and cover all nine requested features in full-feature beta December 7–20; coaching reaches testers only in reviewed eligible scope; record actual gym, offline/reconnect, restart/resume and program/rest findings.

Name: Fix beta issues and run release regressions
Completion criteria: Triage and fix issues throughout the rolling beta; after December 6, run final release regressions across all nine features, account switching/deletion, offline edits/deletions followed by reconnect sync, feed privacy, timers and background/resume; automated and device checks pass with no known data-loss defects.

Name: Prepare store assets and privacy disclosures
Completion criteria: Icons/splash, screenshots, listing, support contact and privacy/account-deletion disclosures match shipped behavior and enabled services, including account sync, friends feed, music metadata and supplements.

Name: Approve release candidate and submit
Completion criteria: Candidate passes feature/data/device gates; choose rollout and confirm store submission/approval status for each platform.

Name: Resolve store feedback and keep release buffer
Completion criteria: Handle review feedback and regressions; retain a tested candidate and documented go/no-go decision.

Name: Release v1 when all gates pass
Completion criteria: Launch only after required reviews, store approvals and verification; record release version and support/issue follow-up.

Name: Optional backup and restore
Completion criteria: Define and implement reviewed export/restore and opt-in backup with clear ownership and preservation of existing local data; reconnect synchronization is tracked separately in F06.

Name: Feed
Completion criteria: Build opt-in compact workout/PR sharing with friend controls and tested audience permissions; retries create no duplicate events, deletion/unsharing removes visibility, and private notes/full raw logs stay private.

Name: Plan health and nutrition integrations
Completion criteria: Choose providers and permission/data boundaries after v1 proves the core lifting flow.

Name: Expand adaptive coaching and hosted import
Completion criteria: Design permanent adaptation and durable decision history; add provider consent, auth, quotas, privacy and server controls before hosted AI.

Name: Vacation mode
Completion criteria: Choose travel dates and available equipment; generate a reviewed editable temporary routine using suitable catalog exercises; preserve the home program/history and explicitly restore the regular schedule.

Name: Notes to self
Completion criteria: Add/edit/delete private workout notes, retain them through offline save/reload and history corrections on native/web, and keep them out of social publishing. Exercise-specific notes can extend the first scope.

Name: Recaps
Completion criteria: Provide completion and weekly recaps from actual saved sessions: working sets, volume, workout time, PRs and consistency; handle empty/sparse data, timed work/rest days and refresh after corrections.

Name: Music listened to
Completion criteria: Manually attach a song/playlist name or link to a workout and show it in history; define provider choice and consent/permissions before separately adding automatic listening capture.

Name: Supplements
Completion criteria: Privately record a supplement name, optional amount/unit/time and notes; edit/delete and offline reload work; recap inclusion is optional.

Name: Offline mode with reconnect sync
Completion criteria: Keep logging offline; account-owned pending changes, including agreed notes, music, supplement, duration and vacation records, survive restart and sync on reconnect with deduplicated retries, conflict/error visibility, edits/deletions and account isolation; guest data stays local until explicitly associated and derived feed events respect private-sharing boundaries.

Name: Workout time
Completion criteria: Show elapsed session time and save duration in history/recaps; define whether pauses count and persist excluded pause intervals; verify background/restart/resume behavior without confusing duration with timed exercise sets.

Name: Rest timer
Completion criteria: Provide an adjustable start/pause/reset/skip countdown between sets; restore correctly after navigation/background/restart; completion cues respect permissions, coexist with workout reminders and never automatically log sets.
